title: Inflection Point Acquisition Corp. III 8-K Filing — 2026-04-24
summary: Inflection Point Acquisition Corp. III filed a Form 8-K on April 24, 2026, disclosing the appointment of Jae Hyun (James) Park as an independent Class II director and Audit Committee member. Park is an investment professional with experience in cross-border capital markets, SPAC transactions, and natural resources, currently serving as Executive Chairman of Keystone Acquisition Corp.
key_points: Jae Hyun (James) Park appointed as independent Class II director on April 24, 2026
Park also appointed to the Board's Audit Committee as a member
Park currently serves as Executive Chairman of Keystone Acquisition Corp. (SPAC established November 2025)
Park was formerly Representative of East Asia for USA Rare Earth from March 2021 to December 2025
Prior to this, Park spent approximately ten years at KPMG in external and internal audit functions
Company entered into standard Indemnity Agreement and Letter Agreement with Park on April 24, 2026
